_readme: H1237: recorded engine voices per family. Bands are named RPM tiers
(idle, idle_low, low, low_med, med, med_high, high, very_high,
maxRPM); the two bands bracketing current RPM crossfade, and each
band's on/off takes crossfade by throttle. Give a band {on,off} for
a load pair, or {single} when one take covers both.
Families: i4 i6 v6 v8 v10 v12 f4(boxer) rot(rotary) b2 b4 hd(harley).
Any family not listed here keeps the procedural pulse-synth voice.
